conbody.p: An archived agent is out of the team: it leaves the hierarchy and cannot be run, and its runs and proposals stay. They are listed under Archived beneath the hierarchy; Reinstate puts one back where it was. To archive an agent, open it with Edit and tick Archive this agent. Archiving is the way to retire an agent you may want back: deleting one also deletes its runs and the automations that use it.
On a phone the groups stack in one column; tap a group's header to fold it.
Crews, the graphs of agents the Crew page used to build, have been removed; the hierarchy is how agents are arranged now.
